scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n web,api "npm run dev -w @partypick/web" "npm run dev -w @partypick/api"
scripts.build:shared: npm run build -w @partypick/contracts && npm run build -w @partypick/matching
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @partypick/api && npm run build -w @partypick/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.tools.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @partypick/api && playwright test
